title: leucanthemum odoratum
intro: Leucanthemum odoratum, commonly known as the Scented Oxeye Daisy, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. Its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum odoratum include antispasmodic, antiseptic, and diuretic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, although more research is required to confirm these findings.
